theme:ai-power.value: 2026-10-13 The Energy Department offered Vistra a conditional loan of up to $4.2 billion (announced Oct 5) for uprates and upgrades at Beaver Valley, Davis-Besse and Perry. The work adds 433 MW, keeps nearly 4 GW of nuclear online for 20 more years and backs a 2.6 GW power deal with Meta. Cheap federal money for uprates lowers the cost of new nuclear output for data centers.
theme:ai-power.was: 2026-10-10 Oracle sent a force majeure notice on Project Jupiter, a site designed for up to 2.45 GW of Bloom fuel cells, after its gas pipeline slipped to Feb 1, 2027; Oracle says the project is on schedule. Separately, Blue Energy filed to connect a Texas gas plus nuclear plant to ERCOT, starting with about 1 GW of GE Vernova turbines. On site power still depends on gas hookups, and turbine orders keep landing at GE Vernova.

theme:robotics-automation.value: 2026-10-13 XPeng set a timeline for its IRON humanoid at its Oct 12 Paris event: mass production by the end of 2026, deliveries in the first half of 2027, starting in stores and malls, and Europe later in 2027. Separately, a Wall Street Journal report says Walmart is still struggling to automate its US warehouses and that Symbotic does not expect a workable in store model until 2028.
theme:robotics-automation.was: 2026-10-12 Two green lights for autonomy. Waymo closed a $5 billion term loan, its first debt, led by Pimco, Blackstone and Sixth Street. And the FMCSA granted a five year exemption (Oct 7, 2026 to Oct 7, 2031) that lets driverless trucks use cab mounted beacons instead of warning triangles, removing the last routine task that needed a person on board.

theme:critical-materials.value: 2026-10-11 The rare earth deadline moved. The US China truce, which keeps China's October 2025 rare earth rules suspended, now runs to January 10, 2027 instead of November 10, 2026, per Bessent (Sep 23) and China's commerce ministry (Sep 28). Western producers get two more months without a supply shock, but the ministry statement does not name rare earths, so watch for a formal notice.
theme:critical-materials.was: 2026-10-10 Freeport's Grasberg mill ran at about 67% of normal in Q3 2026, short of the earlier 85% goal, and the new target is 80% by mid 2027. Copper supply stays tighter for longer, with COMEX copper about $6.66/lb on Oct 9.

theme:defense-reshoring.value: 2026-10-10 Raytheon won a multiyear SM-3 Block IB interceptor contract worth up to $6.3 billion, about $4.4 billion of it in the base years, with work through 2034. Missile defense money keeps moving into multiyear deals, which gives RTX and its suppliers years of visibility.

theme:space-quantum-cyber.value: 2026-10-12 IonQ agreed to buy zero trust network security firm Elisity for up to $1.3 billion in stock (reported Oct 12 by Investor's Business Daily and by CNBC citing the Wall Street Journal). It is IonQ's latest all stock deal after Oxford Ionics and SkyWater, pushing it further into security; the shares fell more than 2% premarket.
theme:space-quantum-cyber.was: 2026-10-10 The FCC approved SpaceX's plan for 15,000 direct to phone satellites (order dated Oct 6), though use of the EchoStar bands waits on a close expected by Nov 30, 2027. DARPA moved IonQ and IBM into the final stage of its quantum benchmarking program on Oct 7; IonQ's deal is worth up to $300 million through 2029.

theme:healthcare-medtech.value: 2026-10-13 UnitedHealth beat and raised 2026 adjusted EPS to at least $20.50 as its medical care ratio fell to 88.4% from 89.9% a year ago. J&J raised 2026 sales guidance to about $101.2 billion and adjusted EPS to $11.10 at the midpoints, with a talc settlement charge cutting GAAP EPS to $0.09. Medtronic rose 3.9% on 2.3x normal volume Oct 12 after its oversubscribed MiniMed swap.
theme:healthcare-medtech.was: 2026-10-12 Medtronic's MiniMed swap was oversubscribed (preliminary results Oct 12). It will accept the maximum 55,032,401 of its own shares for all 252,813,348 MiniMed shares, with only about 18.3% of tendered shares taken; the final count comes Oct 14.

theme:ai-compute.value: 2026-10-13 The memory selloff deepened. Micron closed down 3.88% at $989.04 on Oct 12 and every stock in the SOX fell; on Oct 13 Korea's KOSPI fell about 6% below 6,000 with SK Hynix about -8.5% and Samsung about -6.8%, and Kioxia fell 13% in Tokyo. CXMT says it will launch DDR5 server memory on a denser 4F2 design around the end of 2026. Optics were sold too: Lumentum -9.8% and Coherent -7.9% on Oct 12, on profit taking rather than any demand news.
theme:ai-compute.was: 2026-10-12 Memory chips broke down on Oct 12: Korea's KOSPI fell 3.65% as foreigners sold Samsung (-4.39%) and SK Hynix (-4.52%) for a tenth straight day, and Micron was down about 2% premarket after China's CXMT put its fifth generation DRAM platform into mass production (about 10% of world DRAM in Q2). Optical names rose premarket (Lumentum about +5%, Coherent about +3.4%), so AI money is rotating from memory to optics rather than leaving.

theme:fintech-crypto-rails.value: 2026-10-13 Bank results split on Oct 13: JPMorgan missed on earnings ($5.57 vs $5.93) and revenue ($50.17B vs $51.23B) as expenses rose 12%, while Citi beat ($2.85 vs $2.62, revenue up 8%). Separately, Morgan Stanley pushed its tokenized stock trading target to Q1 2027 from the second half of 2026, saying market plumbing and rules need more time.
theme:fintech-crypto-rails.was: 2026-10-12 US spot bitcoin ETFs had $681 million of outflows last week, the largest weekly withdrawal since June, and bitcoin traded near $83,400 on Oct 12 (CoinDesk). The Financial Stability Board also warned that crisis plans for stablecoins are untested, especially for multi issuer coins like USDC.

industry:financials.value: 2026-10-13 Morgan Stanley moved its target for tokenized stock trading on its alternative trading system to Q1 2027 from the second half of 2026 (said Oct 12 at TOKEN2049), citing market plumbing, products and rules that still need time. It still sees tokenized real world assets reaching $3 to $10 trillion by 2030, against about $39 to $40 billion today.
industry:financials.was: 2026-10-12 Treasury issued its first GENIUS Act rule (an interim final rule reported Sep 30): stablecoin issuers above $10 billion must move to the federal framework within 360 days unless waived, which shuts the state route for Tether and Circle. The OCC says its own final rule is targeted for November.

industry:healthcare.value: 2026-10-11 FDA accepted Intellia's lonvo-z filing with priority review and set a March 10, 2027 decision date, with no advisory panel planned. The first in vivo CRISPR approval now has a date, and chronic HAE drug makers have a clock on them.

industry:industrials.value: 2026-10-13 Symbotic announced on Oct 13 that it is buying cellumation, a Bremen sortation company whose software driven floor replaces fixed conveyors. At the same time a Wall Street Journal report says Walmart's warehouse automation keeps hitting breakdowns and that Symbotic does not expect a workable in store pickup model until 2028, which pushes out the 400 store option.

industry:technology.value: 2026-10-12 IonQ agreed to buy Elisity, a zero trust network security company, for up to $1.3 billion in stock (reported Oct 12). It is a revenue and product grab, not a quantum milestone, and it adds dilution.

industry:transportation.value: 2026-10-12 Waymo closed a $5 billion term loan, upsized from about $3 billion and priced at 5.25 points over the benchmark rate, to expand its fleet in the US and abroad. Lenders funding robotaxis is a sign the business is moving from research to fleet operations.

country:argentina.value: 2026-09-29 An IMF mission to Buenos Aires ended Sep 29 without closing the third program review. Reserves near $48.7 billion and a peso well inside its band support the case, but the review is still pending.

country:brazil.value: 2026-10-13 AtlasIntel's runoff poll for Bloomberg (Oct 3 to 8, 5,026 people, released Oct 9) gives Flavio Bolsonaro 52.8% of valid votes to Lula's 47.2%, wider than Datafolha's 52% to 48%. Bolsonaro rose from 47.4% to 51.1% of total votes since Atlas's last poll, breaking the earlier tie.
country:brazil.was: 2026-10-09 September inflation came in at 0.82% for the month and 4.58% over 12 months, above the 4.5% ceiling. The Ibovespa still closed at a new record of 209,067 as runoff polls favored Bolsonaro.

country:china.value: 2026-10-12 China's CXMT said its fifth generation DRAM platform (G5) is in mass production, and it held about 10% of world DRAM in Q2 2026. Memory stocks fell on Oct 12: Micron about 2% premarket, Samsung and SK Hynix more than 4% in Seoul. Separately, the Oct 9 EU-China understanding would roughly halve Chinese hybrid car exports to Europe over four years.
country:china.was: 2026-10-08 The People's Bank of China said it will not weaken the yuan to gain a trade edge and will publish more currency data from 2027, ahead of EU trade talks.

country:europe.value: 2026-10-13 European stocks held up through the global chip selloff. The Stoxx 600 closed up 0.65% at 635.65 on Oct 12 and rose about 0.6% to a one week high early Oct 13, led by banks and energy, because Europe owns few AI chip giants. Disappointing LVMH results weighed on luxury. ASML reports later this week.
country:europe.was: 2026-10-12 The Stoxx 600 rose to about 635 on Monday morning as bank stocks gained 1.5% ahead of earnings and oil briefly eased on Trump's Russia Ukraine 'energy ceasefire' claim, which Russia did not confirm. Spain's bank heavy IBEX led with a 1.3% gain.

country:gulf.value: 2026-10-13 UKMTO reported a crude tanker hit by an unknown projectile while leaving Hormuz on Oct 11 and a product tanker hit on Oct 12, and the IRGC claimed more tanker strikes. Brent settled at $106.65 on Oct 12. Saudi stocks steadied, with the TASI up 0.33% on Oct 13.
country:gulf.was: 2026-10-12 Houthi strikes on Riyadh's airport went on: Saturday's toll rose to at least 13 and a Sunday attack killed one more and wounded 11 (CNN). Iran called the latest US plan to reopen Hormuz 'insufficient', and Brent rebounded above $106 on Monday. Saudi stocks fell 0.15% Sunday and Qatar's index about 1.5%.

country:india.value: 2026-10-13 India's 10 year bond yield rose to 7.37% on Oct 12, its highest since October 2023, even as the rupee bounced about 1% to near 95.76 per dollar on the RBI's new curbs. Bloomberg called the curbs among the strongest currency defenses since the 2013 taper tantrum.
country:india.was: 2026-10-12 The RBI moved to curb dollar demand in the spot market and the rupee rebounded about 1% to near 95.7 per dollar, but the Sensex fell about 0.8% by midday as bond yields rose for a fourth session and foreign outflows kept building.

country:japan.value: 2026-10-13 Japan reopened after a holiday into the chip selloff. The Nikkei fell about 1.7% to 1.8% on Oct 13 as Kioxia dropped 13% and Tokyo Electron 7%, while the broader Topix rose about 0.1%. The damage was in chip stocks, not the whole market.
country:japan.was: 2026-10-09 The yen hit about 158.2 per dollar, its fourth weekly loss, while the Nikkei slipped for a third day. A weak yen helps exporters but raises the odds Japan steps in to support it.

country:mexico.value: 2026-10-13 The peso rebounded 0.73% to about 18.26 per dollar on Oct 12 after last week's slide to its weakest since November 2025. September inflation rose to 3.45% a year from 3.26%, a bit under the 3.47% forecast. Banxico's next decision is Nov 5 at 6.50%.
country:mexico.was: 2026-10-09 The peso slid to about 18.41 per dollar, its weakest since November 2025, as the carry trade unwound. That hurts dollar earnings of Mexican companies and helps exporters and tourism.

country:south-korea.value: 2026-10-13 The KOSPI fell about 6% on Oct 13, below 6,000 for the first time since August, and a sell sidecar paused program selling. SK Hynix fell about 8.5% and Samsung about 6.8%, with SK Square down about 12%.
country:south-korea.was: 2026-10-12 The KOSPI fell 3.65% to 6,384.24, its lowest close since Aug 11, as foreigners sold a net 2.02 trillion won for a tenth straight day. Samsung fell 4.39% and SK Hynix 4.52%, and China's CXMT said a new memory platform is in mass production.

country:taiwan.value: 2026-10-13 The Taiex fell 1.95% to 48,341 on Oct 13 as foreign investors sold a net NT$165 billion, the third largest foreign sale on record, after the US chip selloff and Korea's crash. TSMC fell 1.97% to NT$2,490 two days before its results.
country:taiwan.was: 2026-10-08 TSMC reported September sales of NT$511.9 billion, up 54.6% from a year ago, and record Q3 sales of NT$1.494 trillion, above the NT$1.46 trillion LSEG estimate. AI chip demand is still rising.
